Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for an existing side-scrolling 2D fantasy platformer. Create a wide 16:9 landscape, 1536x864 or larger. Style: richly detailed painterly pixel art, crisp tiny pixel clusters, nostalgic premium RPG environment, atmospheric layered distance, consistent with a lush teal forest RPG. Scene is entirely background scenery: NO playable platforms, no floating ledges, no foreground ground strip, no characters, no UI, no text, no watermark. Side-on landscape composition with landmarks readable in the upper and middle distance. Keep the central play area open, low contrast, and airy so three tiers of separately rendered combat platforms and tiny characters will remain readable; detailed framing only at the far sides. Rich material detail, elegant light, depth haze, restrained saturation.
Primary request: Taiwan Jiufen hillside town at blue-hour dusk: staggered old wooden tea houses, dark slate tiled roofs, warm amber windows and red paper lanterns on both side slopes, misty emerald mountain coastline across an open central valley, distant sea. Romantic rainy cobblestone town atmosphere, warm amber versus cool blue-teal. Avoid prominent close stairs across center.
